title: Cap. II open: Variæ sententiæ — election from foresight merits; agenda
pass_a_gloss: CAP. II. The various opinions of those are rehearsed who have taught that election rests upon our foresight merits. Let us approach at last to the very business to which we have destined this our labor. And first we will dispute concerning Election or Predestination unto salvation and eternal blessedness: thereafter we will come to that other part of this controversy, concerning Non-election, Passing-by, or reprobation. Key lemmas: variae sententiae (various opinions); merita praevisa (foresight merits); electio / praedestinatio; non-electio / praeteritio / reprobatio.
pass_b_english: CAP. II. Here I set out the various opinions of those who teach that election rests on our foresight merits. We come at last to the business this labor was meant for. First we will argue election — or predestination — to salvation and eternal blessedness; then the other half of the controversy: non-election, passing-by, or reprobation.
source_text: CAP. II. Variae illorum sententiae referuntur, qui electionem praevisis nostris meritis inniti docuerunt. Accedamus tandem ad ipsum negotium cui hanc operam nostram destinavimus. Et primo de Electione sive Praedestinatione ad salutem & aeternam beatitudinem disputabimus: dein ad illam alteram hujus controversiae partem, de Non-electione, Praeteritione, sive reprobatione deveniemus.
